answer_1.quote: This paper studied the task of subjective question answering on products (SUBJPQA).
answer_1.outputs: multi-perspective inductive answers summarizing objective facts and subjective reviews

answer_2.quote: We further used BLEU (B n )  and ROUGE (R n )  to measure the generated quality of the inductive answer.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluations to qualitatively evaluate the answer's quality.
answer_4.guideline: We employed four metrics, including Factness (Fact) and Accuracy (Acc) to measure its objective part, Comprehensiveness (Comp) and Template Compliance (Tcp) for subjective part.
